description: This Java class implements the GLIMAccountInfoReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to retrieve GLIM account information, group loan monitoring accounts, and repayment templates from a database for a loan management system.

classes.name: GLIMAccountInfoReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the GLIMAccountInfoReadPlatformService interface, responsible for querying GLIM account data from the database.

classes.name: GLIMFieldsMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL result set to GroupLoanIndividualMonitoringAccountData objects, based on specific GLIM account fields.

classes.name: GLIMMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL result set to GroupLoanIndividualMonitoringAccountData objects, used for broader GLIM account details.

classes.name: GLIMRepaymentMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping SQL result set to GlimRepaymentTemplate objects, fetching repayment template details.

methods.name: findGlimAccountsByGLIMId
methods.description: Fetches GLIM accounts associated with a specific GLIM ID.

methods.name: findGlimAccountsByGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves GLIM accounts linked to a specific group ID.

methods.name: findGlimAccountByGroupId
methods.description: Fetches GLIM account data for a given group ID.

methods.name: findGlimAccountByParentAccountId
methods.description: Fetches GLIM account data based on a parent account number.

methods.name: findGlimAccountByGroupIdandAccountNo
methods.description: Retrieves GLIM account data for a specific group ID and account number.

methods.name: findGlimAccount
methods.description: Fetches all GLIM accounts associated with a given group ID and related detailed account info.

methods.name: findGlimAccountbyGroupAndAccount
methods.description: Fetches GLIM accounts by group ID and account number, with detailed account info.

methods.name: findglimRepaymentTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves repayment template details for a specified GLIM ID.
